literature_supported_correction: SciPy1.17 VODE was a C port with an upstream confirmed analytical dense Jacobian transpose bug; earlier observations do not rank original Fortran VODE.
numerically_checked_findings: All three native solver arms completed all 756 main accuracy configurations.
All ten physical case/grid groups matched nominal achieved error within a factor of two and all three initial-step scales below the common error anchor.
VigilODE fast had lower measured times on the selected Robertson, HIRES and van der Pol configurations.
Netlib DVODE remained 1.7676 to 2.1886 times shorter than VigilODE banded on the four spatial case/grid configurations.
All 42 paired medians and the independent vectorized error metrics were recomputed from retained refined raw observations.
archival_limit: Main screening omitted two >20MiB raw gzip files. Final matched run retains full state objects and per-repeat timing rows, with no split or omitted state object.
